timeline.detail: Escalated with findings to engineering team

symptoms.description: Ad service p95 latency is 3450ms (> 150ms baseline)

root_cause.description: Ad service container is severely CPU throttled (quota 0.1 CPU). Container restarting is not a remedy for host CPU starvation.

evidence.ref: ad CPU 99.8% of 0.1 CPU quota, high throttle periods
evidence.why_it_matters: Confirmed CPU starvation with no software fault signature

escalation.reason: No approved automated remediation for CPU starvation. Container restart rejected by policy.
escalation.findings: Container ad is pinned to 0.1 CPU quota. Escalated to platform engineering to adjust compose CPU limits.

prevention.change:
groups:
  - name: oncall-preventive-rules
    rules:
      - alert: HighErrorRateAd
        expr: container_memory_usage_bytes{container_label_com_docker_compose_service="ad"} > 300000000
        for: 1m
        labels:
          severity: critical
          service: ad
        annotations:
          summary: "Elevated error rate observed on ad"
          description: "Error ratio exceeded threshold for over 1 minute."
prevention.rationale: Detect resource_exhaustion_cpu on ad before full user impact occurs.
prevention.validation_detail: Valid PromQL expression verified against Prometheus

prevention.rationale: Enforce bounded memory limits on ad to avoid host OOM starvation.
prevention.validation_detail: Config syntax verified against compose spec

prevention.change:
Add request timeout deadline propagation and input validation:
- Enforce 2.0s maximum handler deadline.
- Return HTTP 400 immediately on malformed charge/cart payloads.
prevention.rationale: Prevent hanging handler threads and unhandled edge case exceptions.
